verses: Mein uss shehar ki qasam khata hun
Aur aap uss shehar mein muqeem hain
Aur (qasam hai) insani baap aur aulad ki
Yaqeenan hum ney insan ko (bari) mushaqqat mein peda kiya hai
Kiya yeh guman kerta hai kay yeh kissi kay bus mein hi nahi?
Kehta (phirta) hai kay mein ney to boht kuch maal kharach ker dala
Kiya (yun) samjhta hai kay kissi ney ussay dekha (hi) nahi?
Kiya hum ney uss ki do aankhen nahi banayen
Aur zaban aur hunt(nahi (nahi banaye)
Hum ney dikha diye uss ko dono raastay
So uss say na ho saka kay ghaati mein dakhil hota
Aur kiya samjha kay ghaati hai kiya?
Kissi gardan (ghulam londi) ko aazad kerna
Ya bhook walay din khana khilana
Kissi rishtay daar yateem ko
Ya khahsaar miskeen ko
Phir unn logon mein say ho jata jo eman latay aur aik doosray ko sabar ki aur reham kerney ki wasiyat kertay hain
Yehi log hain dayen bazoo walay (khush bakhti walay)
Aur jin logon ney humari aayaton kay sath kufur kiya yeh kum bakhti walay hain
Unhi per aag hogi jo charon taraf say gheri hui hogi
